description: This file defines an abstract base class for Skills API configuration in a machine learning or LLM-related project. It sets the structure for provider-specific implementations to handle API URL transformations, request preparations, and response transformations related to skills management (creating, listing, retrieving, deleting skills).

classes.name: BaseSkillsAPIConfig
classes.description: An abstract base class that defines the interface for skills API configuration, including methods for URL construction, request/response transformation, and error handling.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Constructor for the base skills API config class (currently does nothing).

methods.name: LlmProviders custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Abstract property that should return the LlmProviders enum indicating the provider.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams] )
methods.description: Abstract method for validating and updating request headers based on provider-specific requirements.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], endpoint: str, skill_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL given base URL, endpoint, and optional skill ID.

methods.name: Dict transform_create_skill_request( self, create_request: CreateSkillRequest, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms a CreateSkillRequest into a provider-specific request body.

methods.name: Skill transform_create_skill_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms a raw HTTP response into a Skill object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_list_skills_request( self, list_params: ListSkillsParams, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms list skills parameters into a request URL and query parameters.

methods.name: ListSkillsResponse transform_list_skills_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms a raw HTTP response into a ListSkillsResponse object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_get_skill_request( self, skill_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares URL and headers for retrieving a specific skill.

methods.name: Skill transform_get_skill_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms a raw HTTP response into a Skill object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_delete_skill_request( self, skill_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares URL and headers for deleting a skill.

methods.name: DeleteSkillResponse transform_delete_skill_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Transforms a raw HTTP response into a DeleteSkillResponse object.

methods.name: Exception get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Provides an exception class for errors, defaulting to BaseLLMException.
